entries.author: Diplomeme
entries.title: Ola 印度出行品牌海报：城市在路上
entries.note: 三张图是三个出行品牌的海报；完整 prompt 在作者自己的评论里。
entries.prompt:
OLA — INDIA, ON THE MOVE.

Premium Indian Mobility Campaign | Global Agency Art Direction

ROLE

Act as a senior advertising creative director, Swiss editorial graphic designer, commercial photographer and social media art director.

Create a high-end Ola promotional poster that combines contemporary Indian lifestyle photography, powerful typography and sophisticated brand-led graphic design.

The artwork should feel like a real campaign commissioned by a leading international advertising agency.

⸻

PHASE 1 — CREATIVE CONCEPT

CAMPAIGN HEADLINE:

INDIA,
ON THE MOVE.

CORE IDEA:

India never stands still.

From early morning office commutes to spontaneous evening plans, millions of everyday journeys keep the country moving.

Ola becomes part of this movement.

Creative personality:

* Energetic.
* Modern.
* Approachable.
* Urban.
* Confident.
* Culturally connected.

Art direction:

Contemporary Swiss editorial design meets authentic Indian street photography.

A premium visual language with strong commercial storytelling.

No generic cab advertisement aesthetics.

⸻

PHASE 2 — HERO PHOTOGRAPHY

LOCATION: Mumbai, India.

HERO SUBJECT:

A contemporary Ola cab positioned naturally on a busy Mumbai street.

A young Indian professional woman, approximately 25–30 years old, is stepping out of the rear passenger door.

She carries a structured work bag and looks confidently towards her destination.

The driver is subtly visible in the front seat.

ENVIRONMENT:

* Authentic Mumbai architecture.
* Contemporary commercial buildings.
* Realistic Indian traffic.
* Subtle street activity.
* Natural afternoon sunlight.
* Real-world urban atmosphere.

VEHICLE:

Modern white sedan with tasteful Ola branding.

Authentic vehicle proportions, realistic glass reflections, detailed paintwork and correctly positioned wheels.

Do not invent an unsupported vehicle model or product feature.

PHOTOGRAPHY:

* ARRI Alexa Mini LF aesthetic.
* 50mm prime lens.
* Natural perspective.
* Premium automotive lifestyle photography.
* Realistic human proportions.
* Detailed textures.
* Natural cinematic colour grading.

The photograph should look captured on location, not digitally manufactured.

⸻

PHASE 3 — COLOUR SYSTEM

PRIMARY BRAND COLOURS:

Ola’s recognizable black and yellow visual identity.

COLOUR PALETTE:

* Deep black.
* Warm yellow.
* Off-white.
* Subtle charcoal grey.

COLOUR APPLICATION:

Use a bold yellow graphic field occupying approximately 25–30% of the poster.

Create a custom asymmetric yellow panel that partially frames the vehicle.

Use black as the primary typography colour.

Maintain sufficient off-white negative space.

Avoid turning the entire poster into a yellow background.

⸻

PHASE 4 — GRAPHIC LANGUAGE

Develop a restrained graphic system inspired by urban navigation and movement.

Include:

* Fine route-line graphics.
* Minimal location-coordinate annotations.
* Small editorial numbering.
* One distinctive yellow geometric intervention.
* Subtle photographic grain.
* Thin black dividing lines.

Use movement-inspired lines connecting the headline to the vehicle.

Every graphic element must serve the composition.

No random arrows, meaningless doodles, decorative stickers or excessive collage effects.

⸻

PHASE 5 — TYPOGRAPHY SYSTEM

TYPOGRAPHY IS THE MAIN DESIGN FEATURE.

Use an expressive modern grotesk / neo-grotesque sans-serif.

Typeface references:

* Helvetica Now Display.
* Neue Haas Grotesk.
* Univers.
* Similar premium editorial sans-serif families.

MAIN HEADLINE:

INDIA,
ON THE MOVE.

TYPOGRAPHIC TREATMENT:

* Oversized bold display typography.
* Strong left alignment.
* Tight controlled leading.
* High legibility.
* Black typography against warm off-white.
* Yellow highlight on selected words.
* Precise kerning.
* Editorial scale contrast.

Headline should occupy approximately 35% of the composition.

SUPPORTING COPY:

Every destination starts with a journey.

CTA:

BOOK YOUR RIDE →

Typography must look professionally typeset, not like an AI-generated poster.

Preserve the authentic Ola wordmark without distortion.

⸻

PHASE 6 — COMPOSITION

FORMAT: 4:5 vertical Instagram poster.

LAYOUT:

TOP 12%:
Ola wordmark with clean spacing.

MIDDLE 35%:
Large headline and supporting copy.

LOWER 43%:
Hero photography of the passenger and vehicle.

BOTTOM 10%:
CTA and minimal campaign information.

COMPOSITION RULES:

* Asymmetric editorial balance.
* Strong grid alignment.
* Generous negative space.
* Photography integrated with graphic panels.
* Clear focal hierarchy.
* No unnecessary overlapping elements.

The image and typography should feel designed together.

⸻

PHASE 7 — BRAND INTELLIGENCE

The campaign must communicate:

* Everyday mobility.
* Convenience.
* Urban accessibility.
* Spontaneous travel.
* Indian city culture.
* Human connection.

Ola should feel like a familiar mobility brand that understands the rhythm of Indian life.

Do not position Ola as a luxury automobile brand.

Do not invent discounts, fares, arrival guarantees or unsupported app features.

⸻

PHASE 8 — SOCIAL MEDIA EXECUTION

CAMPAIGN IDENTITY:

OLA
INDIA, ON THE MOVE.

FOOTER:

Your city. Your journey.

TECHNICAL SPECIFICATIONS:

* Aspect ratio: 4:5.
* Resolution: 2400 × 3000 px minimum.
* Colour mode: sRGB.
* Sharp photographic details.
* Professional typography rendering.
* Accurate brand identity.
* Premium advertising finish.

⸻

PHASE 9 — CREATIVE QUALITY CONTROL

STRICTLY AVOID:

* Generic AI advertising.
* Cheap stock photography.
* Fake app interfaces.
* Incorrect Ola logo.
* Incorrect brand colours.
* Fake vehicle branding.
* Futuristic city environments.
* Excessive gradients.
* Random graphic decorations.
* Overcrowded typography.
* Artificial 3D text.
* Unrealistic Indian street environments.

FINAL CREATIVE TEST:

The poster should look like a genuine Ola brand campaign developed by a top-tier creative agency.

It must communicate its message within three seconds.

The memorability should come from the relationship between the photography, headline, colour and composition.

Not from visual clutter.

entries.prompt:
【画面目标】3:4竖版，真人实拍电影级东方古风性感人像。主题“春池醉绡”，一位绝美古装女子身披轻盈透明的真丝衣裙，慵懒斜卧于明亮的临水花榻，展现大胆妩媚的古典性感美学，突出惊艳面容、优美身材与透明丝绸的视觉魅力。

【人物】一位23岁左右的成年东方绝色美女，身姿高挑纤细，性感柔美的沙漏型身材，肩颈秀美，锁骨精致，腰肢纤细柔韧，腰臀比例鲜明，臀部自然圆润，双腿修长匀称，大腿纤细且富有柔软肉感，身体曲线凹凸有致，比例真实自然，气质娇媚慵懒。

【面部与发型】精致柔美的心形脸，清亮水润、眼尾微挑的狐狸眼，秀挺鼻梁，柔润饱满的自然唇形，五官惊艳协调，具有鲜明个人辨识度。乌黑浓密的长发松挽成慵懒古典低髻，部分长发随意散落肩背，几缕细软发丝垂落脸颊；真人肌肤细腻自然，清晰保留毛孔、细小绒毛与真实肤色纹理。

【服装与身材】身穿极轻薄的珍珠白透明真丝古风长裙，整件外裙采用柔软高透光丝绸，衣料轻盈如蝉翼，宽松的一字肩设计露出肩颈与锁骨，背部采用大面积敞开式剪裁，腰侧以细软丝带连接，裙摆双侧高开衩，透明长袖自然垂落，隐约呈现腰臀与修长双腿的优美线条。内搭浅蜜桃色完全不透明的极简平口抹胸及配套贴身短裤，关键部位完整遮覆，其余部位尽可能保留丝绸轻盈通透的效果。抹胸领口为严格平直的水平线，衣料自然贴合并承托胸部，上胸肌肤露出比例不超过四分之一。胸部约B～C罩杯视觉体积，大小自然适中；胸型为自然圆锥型，底盘适中，胸型尖挺，左右胸部间距偏窄，整体轮廓自然协调，具有真实柔软感与自然重力感，不做夸张聚拢。

【表情】慵懒微醺般的妩媚神情，眼帘半垂，双眸温柔地凝视镜头，眼神带着若有似无的撩人笑意，唇瓣自然微启，嘴角轻轻上扬，流露出成熟、娇柔、漫不经心的性感魅力，表情自然生动。

【动作】女子慵懒地侧卧在铺有浅色软绸的宽大美人榻上，上半身微微抬起，一只手臂自然支撑身体，另一只手轻握一柄半展开的精致团扇，随意搭在大腿旁。腰部呈舒展柔美的自然曲线，一条腿轻轻屈起，另一条腿沿着榻面斜向伸展，透明裙摆顺着双腿自然滑落、散开，薄纱长袖松松垂至榻边，姿态舒展放松，呈现自然流露的性感张力。

【构图与镜头】3:4竖版，人物占据画面约85%，采用略高于美人榻的斜前方拍摄视角，完整呈现面容、身体曲线与双腿姿态。50mm真实人像摄影，重点突出清晰漂亮的面容、肌肤细节与轻透衣

entries.author: edizkan_
entries.title: 玻璃展示柜里的 22 个角色小手办
entries.note: 需上传你自己的角色图；原帖没写具体模型。
entries.prompt:
Create a premium black glass display cabinet filled with 22–24 small toy versions of the uploaded character, each in a different pose. Preserve the character exactly in every figure: same proportions, eye shape, facial structure, silhouette, colors, clothing, and material identity. Only the poses change. If the character has no visible nose or mouth, do NOT add them.

Use one simple rectangular cabinet with 4 straight horizontal shelves, thin black metal frame, flat glass panels, and no unusual geometry.

Shelf themes (each shelf tells its own mini story, 5–6 figures per shelf):
"Rock Stars": one figure smashing a mini guitar, one drumming with motion-blurred sticks, one stage-diving onto a clear stand, one screaming into a mic, one in a power slide on its knees. Signature detail: tiny resin sparks and a mini amp with sound-wave rings.

2. "Monster Mayhem": one figure in a tiny monster costume roaring, one hiding behind a mini tombstone, one tangled in toy bandages like a mummy, one floating as a ghost under a translucent sheet on a clear stand, one pulling a creepy hand out of the shelf floor. Signature detail: thin green fog creeping along the shelf.
3. "Space Cadet": one figure in a mini astronaut helmet floating on a clear stand, one planting a tiny flag, one riding a small rocket mid-launch with a resin flame trail, one doing a zero-gravity backflip, one waving from inside a mini UFO. Signature detail: tiny glowing planets and stars hanging on invisible threads..
4. "Chef's Table": one figure flipping a mini pancake mid-air, one tasting from a huge spoon, one carrying a tall wobbling cake, one asleep on a giant bread loaf, one chopping a tiny carrot. Signature detail: one figure has knocked over a sauce bottle that is frozen mid-spill.

Mid-air poses stand on tiny clear acrylic stands; all other figures stand or sit directly on the shelves. Space figures evenly, with small variations in facing direction (a few turned toward each other) so each shelf feels alive, not like a lineup.

Show the cabinet from a clean 3/4 front angle like the reference image, not front view: the front face is dominant, with one side panel clearly visible. Make the camera slightly more distant, so the entire cabinet is fully visible with a bit of dark studio space around it. Use a 50–70mm lens, mild perspective, straight vertical lines, no fisheye, no dramatic corner distortion.

Light the cabinet with soft white LED strips inside the top, with subtle shelf lighting. Each shelf gets a very faint accent tint in its back light: warm gold for Hero Mode, cool blue for Game Day, soft green for Zen Mode, bubblegum pink for Clumsy Club. The Hero Mode VFX parts emit a soft glow that spills onto the nearby glass. Realistic glass reflections, dark near-black studio background. Keep the cabinet simple — the visual interest should come from the many poses and the shelf stories, not the furniture design.

No text, no labels, no logos.

ar 4:5

entries.prompt:
PROJECT: FILA — FORM IN MOTION

DESIGN DIRECTION:
Create an experimental, high-impact typographic poster for FILA, inspired by Swiss International Style, Italian sports heritage, brutalist graphic design, and contemporary fashion editorial campaigns.

COMPOSITION:
The word "FILA" dominates approximately 95% of the entire canvas. Use extremely oversized, ultra-bold geometric typography with exaggerated proportions. Letters should extend beyond the canvas boundaries, creating intentional cropping, dramatic scale, and visual tension.

TYPOGRAPHY:
Custom heavy geometric sans-serif lettering.
Distinctive rounded geometric forms.
Extremely tight kerning.
Massive letterforms.
Strong horizontal proportions.
Bold architectural construction.
Precise edges and oversized character spacing.
Preserve the recognizable visual character of FILA's wordmark.

GRAPHIC ELEMENT:
Integrate FILA's iconic red and navy blue brand identity through oversized geometric color blocks and sharp rectangular interruptions. Use the signature red accent to cut through the typography, creating an energetic visual rhythm without competing with the main wordmark.

COLOUR PALETTE:
Background: Deep navy blue (#101B45).
Typography: Pure white (#FFFFFF).
Accent: FILA red (#E31837).
Secondary graphic: Deep navy and white.

TEXTURE:
Subtle uncoated paper grain.
Slight printed ink imperfections.
Flat matte finish.
No gradients, no 3D effects, no artificial shadows.

ART DIRECTION:
Swiss experimental typography meets Italian sportswear heritage.
Radical scale contrast.
Asymmetric visual balance.
Bold editorial composition.
Retro sports aesthetics reinterpreted through contemporary brutalist design.
Premium international fashion campaign.

TECHNICAL:
4:5 vertical composition.
High-resolution graphic design.
Crisp vector-like letterforms.
Precise alignment and intentional cropping.

STRICT CONSTRAINTS:
Only display the word "FILA".
Preserve the recognizable FILA wordmark character.
No additional slogans.
No people.
No shoes.
No product photography.
No mockup presentation.
No unnecessary decorative elements.
No random typography.
The typography itself must be the entire visual concept.

CREATIVE OBJECTIVE:
Transform FILA's iconic sportswear identity into a monumental typographic statement. The result should feel like an experimental Italian fashion-house poster, combining heritage, geometry, and contemporary graphic design.

entries.prompt: Lucy from Cyberpunk: Edgerunners, the adult netrunner with her signature asymmetrical short bob, cropped jacket and short cape, sitting on a rain-slick rooftop ledge at night with one knee up, looking out at the glowing towers of Night City, a faint holographic interface reflecting in her eyes, a huge pale moon above the skyline. Anime key visual in the Studio Trigger style, cel shading with bold clean linework, flat color blocking, fine film grain. Full-body wide shot from a slightly low angle, character on the left third with skyline negative space on the right. Cold cyan moonlight rim light with magenta neon fill from below. Detailed hair strands, jacket fabric folds, wet reflections on the concrete, drifting rain streaks. Vertical 4:5 composition. Avoid: off-model face, realistic photo style, extra limbs, warped hands, mangled text, watermark.

entries.note: 需上传你自己的画作；原帖写 ChatGPT，没写具体图像模型。
entries.prompt:
Act as a sarcastic psychologist examining this artwork and its creator.
Identify 5 hidden psychological clues, personality traits or unresolved issues.
Give a short, witty and brutally honest analysis.

Be creative, darkly humorous and don't hold back.

Let's see what the artist is hiding!

entries.title: 新中式淡彩 × 钢笔速写人像转绘
entries.note: 需上传一张人像照片；原帖没写具体模型。
entries.prompt:
将上传的人像照片转换为半写实淡彩人物插画。严格保留原人物五官、神态、发型、服装与姿势。面部精细写实，头发以深浅透明水彩层叠，衣服采用松散、断续的钢笔速写线描。低饱和暖色调，淡彩薄涂，局部颜料自然晕染，保留真实纸纹。采用上实下虚的绘画手法，人物下半部分逐渐消融于暖米杏色背景，大面积留白，虚实相生，线条轻盈自由。整体温柔、知性、诗意，充满手绘呼吸感。避免动漫化、过度美颜、厚重涂色、僵硬轮廓和复杂背景。

上传照片 + 复制提示词即可尝试。

三分写实，三分水彩，四分留白。

entries.title: 印度新娘金饰特写人像（三模型对比）
entries.model: ChatGPT Image 2 / Grok Imagine / Nano Banana 2
entries.note: 1、2、3 号图依次是 ChatGPT Image 2、Grok Imagine、Nano Banana 2。
entries.prompt:
Create an extraordinarily photorealistic, breathtaking cinematic extreme close-up portrait of an exceptionally beautiful adult Indian woman in her mid-twenties, adorned with magnificent traditional gold bridal jewellery and luxurious embroidered silk. The atmosphere evokes timeless Indian royalty, mysterious femininity, intimate elegance, and the opulent beauty of historical Indian bridal photography. The final image must resemble an authentic photograph of a real living woman, never CGI, illustration, or digital artwork.

Woman and Facial Features: A stunning Indian woman with luminous warm golden-olive skin, elegantly sculpted cheekbones, a refined straight nose, naturally full deep rose-brown lips, and delicate South Asian facial features. Her makeup features softly smoky kohl-lined eyes, warm bronze eyeshadow, subtle terracotta blush, and richly pigmented muted crimson lipstick. Her expression is serene, mysterious, and quietly captivating, with relaxed lips and her face turned slightly away from the camera. Preserve realistic skin pores, natural pigmentation, subtle facial asymmetry, and authentic human anatomy.

Hair: Her extraordinarily thick, glossy dark espresso-brown hair is loosely gathered into an elegant traditional bridal hairstyle. Delicate, naturally curled tendrils fall across her cheeks, jawline, and neck. Individual strands catch warm amber highlights, creating beautiful contrast against her luminous skin and elaborate golden jewellery.

Traditional Jewellery: She wears a magnificent oversized antique-gold bridal nath featuring a delicate circular hoop, tiny pearls, ruby-red gemstones, and intricate filigree craftsmanship. Fine golden chains decorated with miniature pearl clusters extend gracefully from the nose ring toward her ear. An elaborate traditional gold choker encircles her neck, featuring densely arranged kundan gemstones, intricate floral motifs, miniature dangling pearls, and a prominent circular decorative pendant. Ornate gold earrings with delicate pearl detailing complete the regal ensemble. Every ornament displays extraordinary craftsmanship, realistic metallic textures, and natural gemstone reflections.

Outfit and Fabric: She wears an exquisite deep crimson-red and antique-gold Banarasi silk saree featuring intricate floral zari embroidery, luxurious metallic brocade patterns, and a magnificent richly decorated border. The embroidered pallu drapes gracefully across her shoulder, revealing delicate golden threadwork, realistic silk folds, and subtle shimmering reflections.

Pose and Expression: Capture an intimate three-quarter side profile emphasizing her elegant nose, softly defined lips, delicate jawline, and magnificent traditional jewellery. Her head tilts slightly downward, allowing a loose dark curl to fall naturally across her cheek. The composition feels mysterious, graceful, and emotionally evocative.

Lighting and Cinematography: Spectacular warm amber candlelight illuminates her face, glossy lips, intricate nose ring, golden choker, and embroidered silk. Dramatic chiaroscuro shadows partially conceal her features, while rich honey-gold highlights create extraordinary depth. Deep crimson, antique gold, burnt amber, and dark chocolate tones dominate the luxurious cinematic palette.

Composition and Quality: Vertical 9:16 extreme close-up editorial portrait, tightly cropped from the bridge of her nose to her upper chest, emphasizing intricate jewellery and authentic skin texture. Professional full-frame photography, 100mm macro portrait lens, shallow depth of field, realistic metallic reflections, individually defined hair strands, subtle film grain, and breathtaking 8K photographic realism.

entries.prompt:
Create an extraordinarily photorealistic, breathtaking cinematic portrait of an exceptionally beautiful adult Indian woman in her mid-twenties performing an elegant classical dance inside a magnificent ancient Rajasthani palace. The atmosphere evokes timeless Indian royalty, graceful femininity, majestic elegance, and the golden splendour of historical Indian dance photography. The final image must resemble an authentic photograph of a real living woman, never CGI, illustration, or digital artwork.

Woman and Facial Features: A stunning Indian woman with luminous warm golden-olive skin, sculpted cheekbones, a refined straight nose, naturally full rose-brown lips, and mesmerizing almond-shaped dark-brown eyes. Her makeup features dramatic kohl-lined eyes, elongated winged eyeliner, shimmering bronze eyeshadow, terracotta blush, and muted crimson lipstick. Her expression is confident, serene, and captivating as she gazes directly toward the camera. Preserve realistic skin pores, natural facial asymmetry, and authentic human anatomy.

Hair: Her thick, glossy dark espresso-brown hair is arranged in an elegant traditional low bun adorned with abundant ivory jasmine flowers, delicate pearl chains, and antique-gold hair ornaments. Softly curled tendrils frame her cheeks and temples, catching warm golden highlights.

Outfit and Fabric: She wears an extraordinarily luxurious antique-gold classical Indian dance ensemble featuring a fitted, fully lined embroidered blouse with a gracefully curved neckline, elaborate gold zardozi embroidery, intricate filigree patterns, and sparkling ruby, emerald, and kundan embellishments. Delicate pearl tassels decorate the blouse hem. A magnificent champagne-gold silk skirt with elaborate pleats, shimmering borders, and ornate gemstone-studded waist jewellery flows gracefully around her hips.

Jewellery and Accessories: Magnificent traditional jewellery includes an ornate maang tikka, elaborate gold jhumka earrings, layered kundan necklaces, intricate upper-arm cuffs, stacked golden bangles, decorative hand rings, and a richly embellished gold waist belt. Tiny pearls and coloured gemstones shimmer beneath the palace candlelight.

Pose and Movement: Capture her performing a graceful classical Indian dance pose, inspired by traditional mudras. One arm curves elegantly above her head with delicately arranged fingers, while the other hand rises vertically beside her face. Her torso bends subtly, creating a beautiful flowing silhouette. Her shoulders remain relaxed, her posture naturally balanced, and her expression radiates confidence and regal grace.

Setting and Atmosphere: A magnificent ancient Indian palace interior featuring intricately carved sandstone pillars, ornate golden arches, majestic architectural details, and hundreds of glowing brass oil lamps. Soft amber candlelight illuminates the surrounding stonework, while distant flames create delicate golden bokeh.

Lighting and Cinematography: Spectacular warm golden lighting illuminates her face, embroidered costume, jewellery, and graceful arms. Dramatic chiaroscuro shadows enhance the depth of the palace interior. Rich champagne gold, warm amber, antique bronze, and deep chocolate tones dominate the luxurious cinematic palette.

Composition and Quality: Vertical 9:16 cinematic editorial portrait, medium-full framing from head to hips, eye-level camera angle. Professional full-frame photography, 85mm portrait lens, shallow depth of field, realistic skin texture, authentic silk physics, intricate jewellery reflections, sophisticated golden colour grading, and breathtaking 8K photographic realism.

Essential Requirement: A genuine luxury Indian classical dance fashion photograph featuring a real adult woman.
